title: the shell critic's census says no rule was asked while it reports findings, when shellcheck declines a file in the run
body:
Found by cc on 2026-09-24 in the 3.2.1 doc audit's rules pass, driven on the pair at `4c687eaad`.

Seen: `intent critic shell` printed "0 of 6 rule(s) ASKED" while reporting CRITICAL and WARNING findings from IN-SH-CODE-001 and IN-SH-CODE-002, on a run that included a `.zsh` file shellcheck declines. The decline rewrites the whole rule's disposition (`critic.rs:1484-1489`), so the census understates what ran -- the false-clean direction for a line a reader uses to judge a clean result.

Expected: the census counts the rules that ran on the files they ran on, and names the files a tool declined, separately.

Disposition: vc, 2026-09-24 -- filed for after the stabilisation line.
